FN-EJL6D99-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 67
Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Elections
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/21/2026
House Bill 67 as reported by the Committee on Constitution, Campaigns and Elections would
increase or decrease receipts to the Voter Registration Fund by an undetermined amount
dependent on the difference in collections from: 1) the current one-cent per electronic voter
record fee, set by the Secretary of State under current law; and 2) the amount set by the secretary
up to $1000 per voter list, as provided by this law.
According to the Secretary of State's Office, the office received 874 voter list requests in 2025,
which generated approximately $426,000 in receipts.
